Bladesong Power is a subclass-specific resource for Bladesinging Wizards.

Overview

Bladesong Power is a limited resource that allows Bladesinging wizards to cast their signature ability  Bladesong.

Bladesinger wizards gain 2 charges of Bladesong Power at Level 2 and an additional charge at levels 5 and 9, for a total of 4.

Recovering Bladesong Power charges

Bladesong Power charges are fully replenished on a Long Rest or respeccing with Withers.

Actions using Bladesong Power

Name Cost/Recharge Range/Area Effect
Bladesong  Self Invoke the Bladesong. You gain a +2 bonus to Armour Class and your movement speed increases by 3 m (10 ft). You also gain  Advantage in Acrobatics and a +2 to  Constitution Saving Throws.
